description: Header file defining a vectorized complex double class using VSX intrinsics for CPU vectorization, including operations like arithmetic, trigonometric functions, and complex number manipulations.

classes.name: Vectorized<ComplexDbl>
classes.description: A vectorized complex double class utilizing VSX intrinsics for SIMD operations, supporting complex arithmetic, mathematical functions, and blending operations.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Multiplies two Vectorized<ComplexDbl> instances as complex numbers.

methods.name: operator/
methods.description: Divides two Vectorized<ComplexDbl> instances as complex numbers.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Computes the magnitude (absolute value) of complex numbers.

methods.name: angle
methods.description: Calculates the phase angle of complex numbers.

methods.name: conj
methods.description: Returns the complex conjugate of the vector.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of complex numbers.

methods.name: sqrt
methods.description: Calculates the square root of complex numbers.

methods.name: reciprocal
methods.description: Calculates the reciprocal of complex numbers.
